requirements: R1: Resolve the 'port is already allocated' error for port 18081 on the runtime-observe-db-1 container by remapping its external host port in the docker compose configuration.

slices.title: Resolve docker compose db port conflict
slices.jtbd: When implementing the port configuration fix for this epic, I want to assign an available host port to the database container, so that docker compose starts without driver external connectivity errors.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a local docker daemon with port 18081 occupied,
When docker compose up is run to start the runtime-observe-db-1 container,
Then the container must bind successfully to an alternative port without throwing a bind failure error.
slices.definitionOfDone: The docker compose file is updated, containers start successfully without 500 errors or startup crashes, and the 'port already allocated' error is permanently resolved.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero port conflict errors during environment initialization
